races.name: Newmarket Academy Godolphin Beacon Project Cornwallis Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
The Flying Childers could be the key piece of form, with the third-place finisher FLANN SUNNA selected to enhance his positive profile and come out on top. In The Black has come a long way in a short period of time and given she was almost knocked over in that race, her performance can be upgraded. Mussab looks a solid 2-y-o, while Perfect Strike could have a bigger effort in him over 5f.

  1. FLANN SUNNA (IRE)
  2. IN THE BLACK
  3. MUSSAB

races.name: Godolphin Lifetime Care Oh So Sharp Stakes (Fillies' Group 3)
races.verdict:
NUIT D'ECLAIR has consistently given her running in similar company since her winning debut and this looks a good opportunity for her to deservedly make the breakthrough at this level. Siena Storm wasn't seen to best effect in the Prestige last time and remains with potential, whilst Topaz is also a leading player on the back of her recent win in Italy.

  1. NUIT D'ECLAIR (IRE)
  2. SIENA STORM (GER)
  3. TOPAZ (IRE)

races.name: Thoroughbred Industry Employee Awards Challenge Stakes (Group 2)
races.verdict:
FLORA OF BERMUDA has an excellent record outside of Group 1s this season, winning 3 times and running well when second in the Park Stakes at Doncaster last time, so she is taken to add to her tally. Time To Turn had excuses on his latest outing and could be the biggest threat back down in grade, ahead of Witness Stand.

  1. FLORA OF BERMUDA (IRE)
  2. TIME TO TURN
  3. WITNESS STAND

races.name: bet365 Fillies' Mile (Group 1)
races.verdict:
The form of ROGUE PASSION's Prix d'Aumale success at Longchamp was massively franked on Arc day. She reeled in Sunday's Prix Jean-Luc Lagardère winner Amusingly, with Prix Marcel Boussac runner-up Data almost 4 lengths behind in third. Consequently, Edward Bethell's filly looks the value call over the unbeaten Musical Times, who is already good enough to win most renewals after her romp in the May Hill.

  1. ROGUE PASSION (IRE)
  2. MUSICAL TIMES (IRE)
  3. DANCING DESTINY (IRE)

races.name: bet365 Old Rowley Cup Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for plenty, but ARCHERS BAY resumed his progress when going down to an exciting prospect in Godolphin ownership over C&D a fortnight ago. Just 1 lb higher now returned to handicap company, Marco Botti's colt is fancied to notch his fourth career success at the expense of Study of Words, who also bumped into one at Ascot when last seen in July and has since been gelded. Devil's Peak and Liberate can fight out third.

  1. ARCHERS BAY (IRE)
  2. STUDY OF WORDS (IRE)
  3. DEVIL'S PEAK

races.name: Godolphin Under Starters Orders EBF Boadicea Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
races.verdict:
The vote goes to FORTY YEARS ON, who has proved most progressive in handicaps this season. She looks well worth another chance at listed level, with the forecast rain certainly no harm to her chances. Dance In The Storm again showed plenty of speed when fifth in the Ayr Gold Cup and is still relatively unexposed as a sprinter. She's feared most ahead of The Prettiest Star, who has some classy form, while fast-improving Zen Diva also needs a close look.

  1. FORTY YEARS ON (IRE)
  2. DANCE IN THE STORM
  3. THE PRETTIEST STAR

races.name: Newmarket Pony Academy Pride Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Group 3)
races.verdict:
SILVER LAKE notched a handicap 4-timer in taking fashion at Doncaster and can continue her rise through the ranks by gaining a first pattern-race success. Touleen has yet to get her head in front this season but should be playing a big part here on her form, as should Oaks runner-up Legacy Link if back on her A-game. Noche Clasica appeals as the pick of the older runners.

  1. SILVER LAKE
  2. TOULEEN
  3. LEGACY LINK

races.name: HKJC World Pool Handicap
races.verdict:
Having finished runner up to a next-time-out winner on her penultimate start, BINTOLA bounced right back to her very best when third in a C&D handicap 3 weeks ago. Leaving the impression she can do better again at this trip, Harry Charlton's filly shades preference over Lion of Mali who has enjoyed a highly productive season and wasn't seen to best effect last time. Nanoscience, George Wickham, Commander of Life and Waistcoat are others to consider in a competitive finale.

  1. BINTOLA
  2. LION OF MALI
  3. NANOSCIENCE

races.name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
An expensive breeze-up purchase, BIDSTA went one better than on debut when doing enough to score at Yarmouth last month and she can continue her promising start to defy a penalty. Threelittleangels shaped encouragingly on her first outing and is feared most, ahead of Halliwell Stream.

  1. BIDSTA (IRE)
  2. THREELITTLEANGELS (IRE)
  3. HALLIWELL STREAM (IRE)

races.name: Bet 20 Get 20 With Unibet Nursery
races.verdict:
SOEUR DE FLASH showed improved form on nursery debut when runner-up at Leicester last time, worn down only close home, and she can build on that effort to go one better. Heading the list of dangers is the progressive Laylaty, while Minster Boy remains with potential making his second nursery start.

  1. SOEUR DE FLASH
  2. LAYLATY
  3. MINSTER BOY (IRE)

races.name: Unibet Supports Safer Gambling Handicap
races.verdict:
ARVANA BELLE posted another solid effort when finishing runner-up (for the third time in her last 4 starts) at Ffos Las recently so Rod Millman's filly gets the tentative nod to gain reward for her consistency and make a winning all-weather debut. Miss Mambo has been knocking at the door and fitted with more severe headgear, she's put forward as the main threat. Captive Beauty and Ernie McCrew can fight out third.

  1. ARVANA BELLE (IRE)
  2. MISS MAMBO (IRE)
  3. CAPTIVE BEAUTY (IRE)

races.name: Darley EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
NEWS looked potentially useful when bolting up first time out at Southwell last month and with improvement on the cards, George Boughey's filly gets the verdict to defy a penalty. Lily Pink got back on track last time, but she may have to settle for a third silver medal from 4 outings, while Watch Party is also respected with this step up to 1m expected to suit. Of the newcomers, Red Curry makes most appeal before the benefit of market clues.

  1. NEWS (IRE)
  2. LILY PINK
  3. WATCH PARTY (IRE)

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Both KINETIC IMPACT and Sin City have layoffs to overcome but they are in very capable hands, with the former marginally preferred. Thornthwaite could emerge as the pick of the newcomers and also needs factoring in.

  1. KINETIC IMPACT
  2. SIN CITY
  3. THORNTHWAITE

races.name: Try Unibet's Superboosts Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
This looks wide open but it could be worth siding with dual C&D scorer HAVANA TOUCH who wasn't at his best in the mud at Ayr last time and can bounce back in style here with Billy Loughnane now up. A La Noche remains handily weighted and could emerge as the main danger, although Valentine Boy is another to consider returned to his optimum trip.

  1. HAVANA TOUCH
  2. A LA NOCHE (IRE)
  3. VALENTINE BOY

races.name: Try Unibet's Superboosts Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Lots with chances but GUNFIGHTER looks the way to go given he did well to get up over C&D last time and now has the services of Billy Loughnane for the first time. It'sneverjustone is next on the list after taking a step back in the right direction with his recent Ayr fifth, while Asteverdi and The Hare Rail also need factoring into this open-looking handicap.

  1. GUNFIGHTER (IRE)
  2. IT'SNEVERJUSTONE
  3. ASTEVERDI

races.name: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap
races.verdict:
None of these can be ruled out but at the likely odds STAR TIME is worth siding with to build on the promise of his Haydock sixth and resume winning ways. Hat-trick seeking Meet Me In Meraki rates the obvious threat, while Mountbatten and Sahm Naif need considering.

  1. STAR TIME
  2. MEET ME IN MERAKI
  3. MOUNTBATTEN (GER)

races.name: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap
races.verdict:
BOLD SHOUT caught the eye when an unlucky-in-running fourth at Southwell on his first all-weather run and is taken to build on it and make a winning start on polytrack. Course scorer Red Hat Eagle is feared most on the back of a good Thirsk third, while Strong Voice and Majestic Wave need considering too.

  1. BOLD SHOUT (IRE)
  2. RED HAT EAGLE
  3. STRONG VOICE (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Gold Weekend Autumn Mile Handicap
races.verdict:
A big-field handicap but the claims of BEAGLE BAY are there for all to see having beaten the subsequent John Smith's Cup winner Raammee at Sandown when last seen in June. His subsequent absence is no concern given the yard he represents and looks ahead of his mark. Power Fizz, course specialist Northern Express and Salam Dubawi head the opposition.

  1. BEAGLE BAY (FR)
  2. POWER FIZZ (IRE)
  3. NORTHERN EXPRESS (IRE)

races.name: British EBF 100,000 Final (Colts And Geldings)
races.verdict:
CAPITANO JOSEPI looks a steal having been picked up for a song this year given he made a taking winning debut at Yarmouth and given he'll know more this time, a bigger performance may well be forthcoming. Eve Johnson Houghton has already had a very productive 2026 in sales races and Everatease is favoured by these weights, so needs taking very seriously. Regency Royal completes the shortlist.

  1. CAPITANO JOSEPI (IRE)
  2. EVERATEASE
  3. REGENCY ROYAL (GER)

races.name: William Hill Finale Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A competitive handicap in which GASPACHO is fancied to step up on her belated return, William Haggas' filly very much bred to be at her best over this sort of trip. Similar comments apply to handicap newcomer Harper Violet, with Ed Bethell's Catterick winner Prince of Calypso also respected under a penalty.

  1. GASPACHO
  2. HARPER VIOLET (IRE)
  3. PRINCE OF CALYPSO (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Epic Boosts EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SHARADD could barely have been more impressive when making a successful debut at Haydock and he should prove hard to stop on his second outing. Our Son Oscar rates the obvious danger.

  1. SHARADD (IRE)
  2. OUR SON OSCAR (IRE)
  3. MEHMAS STAR (IRE)

races.name: Parsonage Hotel And Cloisters Spa Nursery
races.verdict:
INSTANT FORCE looked a 5f natural when finding a chunk of improvement to score at Windsor 3 weeks ago and with that race working out well, his opening mark looks lenient. A gelding operation may help Barnaby Rudge get back on the up so he's second choice, ahead of Noble Raider.

  1. INSTANT FORCE (IRE)
  2. BARNABY RUDGE (IRE)
  3. NOBLE RAIDER (IRE)

races.name: Copper Knight Winning-Most Horse Handicap
races.verdict:
Having quickly bounced back to form when landing a small-field conditions event at Beverley 17 days ago, TOCA MADERA remains on the mark he's been competitive from in top-end handicaps this summer and may well be up to defying top weight eased in class. Hallo Spaceboy will find this easier than recent assignments and is feared, as is Baldomero back at 5f from a career-low mark. Copper Knight also deserves an honourable mention with no less than 7 C&D victories to his name.

  1. TOCA MADERA (IRE)
  2. HALLO SPACEBOY
  3. BALDOMERO (IRE)

races.name: PJ Staffing Group Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
DILIGENT RESDEV caught the eye back from a break at Southwell last time and could be ready to strike having now dipped below his last winning mark, with his record here also a positive. Magic Boy remains of interest and is second choice, while the unexposed Kennington took a big step back in the right direction at Goodwood.

  1. DILIGENT RESDEV
  2. MAGIC BOY (GER)
  3. KENNINGTON

races.name: Wasdell Group Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
COOLTOBECARLESS was value for extra when landing a Fakenham bumper in February prior to shaping much better than the distance beaten suggests in a Grade 2 at Aintree on final outing. He makes plenty of appeal now switching to hurdling, especially having run well at this meeting 12 months earlier and given that he's in receipt of weight from the doubly penalised King's Scholar, who does have a 10-lb claimer on again. Herbies Sock, a point winner in April, has joined a respected yard.

  1. COOLTOBECARELESS (IRE)
  2. KING'S SCHOLAR (IRE)
  3. HERBIES SOCK (IRE)

races.name: Wasdell Group Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
SAINT JEANNAIS again looked a fine prospect when winning on hurdling debut at Bangor in May. He gets the nod over well-related Dutch Corner, who's steadily improving for his excellent yard.

  1. SAINT JEANNAIS (FR)
  2. DUTCH CORNER (IRE)
  3. HIVE RUNNER (IRE)

races.name: Good Intents Marquee Hire Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SEVEN KITES made a pleasing start to his hurdling/Rules career when runner-up over C&D in March and is taken to go one better with improvement on the cards. Little Lady Rock raised her game on her first outing for her current yard when just failing under a penalty at Newton Abbot 3 weeks ago and is respected moving up in trip. Crossgales King folded as if amiss when last seen but is likely to pose a threat if back on song.

  1. SEVEN KITES (IRE)
  2. LITTLE LADY ROCK (IRE)
  3. CROSSGALES KING (IRE)

races.name: DragonBet 'Welsh Champion' Hurdle (Limited Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GIBBS ISLAND made a winning reappearance in good style at this fixture 12 months ago, and he may well repeat the feat off the same mark here. Sam Thomas has won the previous 2 renewals of this race and Doctor Blue could have a big say if back on song. Le Beau Madrik is likely to have been primed by the all-powerful Skelton team, while Captain Hugo and Serious Challenge would be serious players if ready to roll.

  1. GIBBS ISLAND
  2. DOCTOR BLUE (FR)
  3. LE BEAU MADRIK (FR)

races.name: DragonBet Persian War Novices' Hurdle (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A good-looking renewal. The vote goes to COSMIC CONNECTION, who took his tally to 3-4 within the space of a couple of months in the spring and Chris Gordon's rapidly-progressive 5-y-o should have no issues with this longer trip. He can take the step up in class in his stride at the expense of Lord Byron, who was narrowly denied at Grade 1 level in Ireland and arrives fit from a spin on the Flat. Stable-switcher North Shore can get the better of La Cote Fleurie for third.

  1. COSMIC CONNECTION (IRE)
  2. LORD BYRON (IRE)
  3. NORTH SHORE (FR)

races.name: DragonBet Daily Dragonboosts Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Third on his hurdling debut, TYPHOON WARRIOR hasn't made much impact in 2 subsequent outings but he could yet do better as he goes handicapping for his leading yard. He gets the vote ahead of Knight Templar, who was successful on his most recent start over hurdles and arrives fit from the Flat, with City of Diamonds one to note on stable debut.

  1. TYPHOON WARRIOR (IRE)
  2. KNIGHT TEMPLAR
  3. CITY OF DIAMONDS (IRE)

races.name: LSL Racing Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MARLACOO was only beaten by a Dan Skelton improver at this fixture 12 months ago. He may go one better on reappearance this time around and belatedly reward his long-suffering supporters. Fasol is readily preferred as the main danger, with Beau Quali and Mostly Sunny others to consider.

  1. MARLACOO (IRE)
  2. FASOL
  3. BEAU QUALI (FR)

races.name: Alan Bushell Racing Remembers Alan Davies Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SHEEZER DIVA has hinted at promise on all 3 qualifying starts and looks the type to do much better now handicapping for her top yard, so she receives the vote. Getarose and Reel Orange are a pair of credible rivals.

  1. SHEEZER DIVA (IRE)
  2. GETAROSE (IRE)
  3. REEL ORANGE (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
STAR GLORY proved her Galway running all wrong back on a more conventional course and looked a shade unlucky not to force a photo when going down narrowly at Naas 7 weeks ago. She sets a good standard here and shades preference over Joseph O'Brien's appealing newcomer Ladies Gossip. Listowel eye-catcher Sonic Sabiha is another warranting a close look with further progress anticipated.

  1. STAR GLORY (IRE)
  2. LADIES GOSSIP (IRE)
  3. SONIC SABIHA (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series (C & G) Maiden
races.verdict:
Those with experience set no more than a fair standard so this could be prime for a newcomer. TAJAC makes appeal on paper starting out for a very shrewd stable and could be the way to go before market clues. Final Ascent is another appealing newcomer who cost plenty and is worthy of note. Thumama Glory, Tio Joao and The Pipeman are a trio of others to consider.

  1. TAJAC (IRE)
  2. FINAL ASCENT (USA)
  3. THUMAMA GLORY (IRE)

races.name: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
BARBAPAPA and Rappell are both potentially well treated returned to polytrack with the former getting the vote from a much lower draw. Iff In Doubt was a big disappointment when well backed last time but could be worth another chance back from a break.

  1. BARBAPAPA (IRE)
  2. RAPPELL (IRE)
  3. IFF IN DOUBT (IRE)

races.name: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
UNA MATATA has been given a chance by the handicapper here and now back at her favoured track she looks the way to go. Boston Max also has winning form here and could prove the chief threat on the back of a solid fourth here after a break, while Mehman and Thaloria also need factoring in.

  1. UNA MATATA (IRE)
  2. BOSTON MAX (IRE)
  3. MEHMAN

races.name: BAR 1 Betting 'First For Football' Handicap
races.verdict:
BOOYEA needs to shrug off a couple of poor efforts but he was fourth off 7 lb higher in the Irish Cambridgeshire only 3 starts back and he's back down in class. Unexposed 4-y-os Naoi and Hellorhighwater head the dangers.

  1. BOOYEA (IRE)
  2. NAOI (IRE)
  3. HELLORHIGHWATER

races.name: View Restaurant At Dundalk Stadium Apprentice Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
AITEALL is less exposed than most of these and Joseph O'Brien's 3-y-o can go one better than he did at Down Royal 11 days ago. The consistent Storm Eric and recent C&D runner-up Jazz Forever are also shortlisted.

  1. AITEALL (IRE)
  2. STORM ERIC (IRE)
  3. JAZZ FOREVER (IRE)

races.name: Halloween Mid-Term Racing At Dundalk Handicap
races.verdict:
CAMINO LAD hasn't looked back since the blinkers went on and can quickly resume winning ways on the back of an excellent recent second here with this step up in trip also a likely plus. Adrian McGuiness' new recruit Serenity Blue could emerge as the main danger, especially if the market vibes are positive, although Showyoutheropes has slipped in the weights and also commands plenty of respect for his in-form stable.

  1. CAMINO LAD (IRE)
  2. SERENITY BLUE
  3. SHOWYOUTHEROPES (IRE)

races.name: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Handicap
races.verdict:
Good claims can be made for all 5 but FIXATION looks the most progressive one and he did well when switched to this surface last year. Tribal Star is next best.

  1. FIXATION (IRE)
  2. TRIBAL STAR (IRE)
  3. POETIC SOUND (IRE)

races.name: Randox Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
A good opening for EURO AGENT, who has run well twice in similar events here this season and did little wrong again at Gowran last week. Orderly Conduct might be the danger on his hurdles debut.

  1. EURO AGENT (IRE)
  2. ORDERLY CONDUCT (IRE)
  3. POETS RAMBLER (IRE)

races.name: Denis Macauley Memorial Novice Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
FACILE OCEAN is taken to resume winning ways in a race that could be run to suit. Lygon Lad looks the chief threat, ahead of Papagei.

  1. FACILE OCEAN (IRE)
  2. LYGON LAD (IRE)
  3. PAPAGEI

races.name: CM Precision Components Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
PRALOGNAN may well land a second C&D success if taking up this engagement. There wasn't much to separate Centaq and Invincible Oscar last time, and they head the dangers.

  1. PRALOGNAN (FR)
  2. CENTAQ (IRE)
  3. INVINCIBLE OSCAR (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
LITTLE GINGER is going the right way and can open his hurdles account at the third attempt. Young Doran is most likely to follow him home.

  1. LITTLE GINGER (IRE)
  2. YOUNG DORAN (IRE)
  3. FUUSLAND (IRE)

races.name: Tennent's NI Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
HOB'S ANGEL looks the percentage call in a competitive handicap. Katie's Casper, Soldier Saint and Youknowme all hold credible claims. Jimli's Cave won this corresponding race in 2024 and is worth noting for support.

  1. HOB'S ANGEL (IRE)
  2. KATIE'S CASPER (IRE)
  3. YOUKNOWME (IRE)

races.name: McGrady Financial Services Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
IAMAGETAWAY hasn't been seen since disappointing at Killarney in May, yet he'd previously gone close (shaped best for a long way) when third at Kilbeggan previously and returning for a new yard boasting a healthy recent strike rate with their jumpers, he could well be worth chancing to get back on track. Chase debutant Ring of Kerry and Down Around are others fancied to be thereabouts in what is a tricky affair.

  1. IAMAGETAWAY (IRE)
  2. RING OF KERRY (IRE)
  3. DOWN AROUND (IRE)

races.name: Northern Ireland On Course Bookmakers Association Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict:
MINI GETAWAY gained a deserved first success at Sligo last week and from her very low base, she may well follow up. King Gris looks an interesting contender up in trip for handicap debut over fences, with Three By Two another to consider on reappearance.

  1. MINI GETAWAY (IRE)
  2. KING GRIS (FR)
  3. THREE BY TWO (IRE)
